person.description: Full-stack software engineer based in Colombia building web applications with .NET, Next.js and AWS. Available for freelance projects and remote roles.

hero.heading: Full-stack software engineer, from idea to production
hero.subtitle: I build web applications end to end: database, API, interface, cloud infrastructure and deployment. Writing production software since 2017.

about.title: About Me
about.heading: I care about software that holds up in production, not just in the demo.
about.content: I'm a Systems Engineer from Universidad Nacional de Colombia. Since 2017 I've built integrations, web and mobile apps, and internal tools. Most recently I was the technical lead of a platform for loan officers in the US financial sector: I designed its architecture and AWS infrastructure, built features across ASP.NET Core, PostgreSQL and Next.js, set up CI/CD with GitHub Actions, and led a team of up to three developers through to the pilot phase, including an experimental AI assistant that answered questions about users' accounts.

service_list.title: Full-Stack Development & Technical Leadership
service_list.description: Web applications with ASP.NET Core or Next.js and PostgreSQL, from architecture and code reviews to guiding small teams to launch.

service_list.title: Cloud Infrastructure & CI/CD
service_list.description: AWS deployments with ECS and CloudFormation, Docker-based environments, and GitHub Actions pipelines for development and production.

service_list.title: Third-Party Integrations
service_list.description: Connecting your product with services like Stripe, Twilio, Google and AWS, with mocked dependencies so end-to-end tests stay reliable.
